Claims extracted from the Chart Fanatics / Naoufel transcript. Note the evidence classes: the Kinfo portion is PARTIALLY_VERIFIABLE because Kinfo is a third-party broker-connected verification surface; the rest is SELF_REPORTED. Every strategy figure shown in the video is a BACKTEST, which this desk prices BELOW self-reported because a backtest is a claim about the past made by whoever chose the parameters.
[2026-08-27] +10 claims from the fxmerge.com archived track-record section (live section 404s; recovered via Wayback CDX, 209 snapshots -> 194 distinct accounts, 49 extracted, 137 unresolved on Wayback rate-limit and RETAINED in the retry queue). MECHANISM COUNT: ZERO. Every one of these is a number with no described mechanism, so every transferable share is 0.0 -- the corpus's value is NEGATIVE knowledge, below.

claims.subject: Naoufel (Ultra Instinct) -- Kinfo-verified portion
claims.mechanism: portfolio of ~150 rule-based algos generated by parameter search, filtered by a multi-stage robustness workflow, rotated against an incubation bank
claims.contradictions: ~$270k of a claimed ~$1M is on Kinfo; the remainder has no stated verification surface. No horizon, starting capital, flows, leverage or drawdown disclosed, so no growth rate is computable and none is recorded

claims.subject: Naoufel -- ES mean reversion (RSI2<20 above SMA200, exit RSI2>70)
claims.mechanism: buy short-term oversold inside an established uptrend; the mechanism is that index futures mean-revert intraday-to-few-days while the long trend filter keeps the trade on the side of the drift
claims.contradictions: this is the published Connors RSI(2) system, in print since ~2008. A backtest of a widely published rule over the period since publication is a crowding measurement, not a discovery

claims.subject: Naoufel -- Gold Rush (buy Thursday, RSI<40, ATR stop, exit 3 bars)
claims.contradictions: the stated rationale -- weekend geopolitical volatility -- does not explain why THURSDAY rather than Friday, and no mechanism is offered for the RSI<40 leg. Recorded with an empty mechanism, which sets its transferable share to zero by construction

claims.subject: Naoufel -- workflow survival rate
claims.mechanism: ~60% of algos that clear the full robustness workflow go on to perform live. Usable as a FAMILY REALITY-GAP prior shape if it can ever be replicated; self-reported and unfalsifiable as stated

claims.subject: Larry Williams -- 10,000% championship year (cited in the same interview)
claims.contradictions: cited BY the interviewee as a cautionary example: peaked near $2M and closed at $1M, a ~50% giveback. This is the round-trip pattern L1.58 exists for, offered here as evidence against chasing the headline number
